actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

dimensions.assessment: Affects volunteer firefighters, emergency medical personnel, search and rescue volunteers, and taxpayers who do not itemize deductions.
dimensions.evidence: volunteer firefighters and emergency medical and rescue personnel

dimensions.assessment: Provides a financial tax benefit valued at $20 per hour of qualified volunteer service up to 300 hours annually, available even to non-itemizers.
dimensions.evidence: Each hour of qualified services rendered by an individual as a bona fide volunteer shall be treated... as a contribution of $20

dimensions.assessment: Reduces federal tax revenues by creating a new charitable deduction for hundreds of thousands of volunteer service hours nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: allowance of deduction to individuals who do not elect to itemize deductions

dimensions.assessment: Amends sections 170 and 63 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to add volunteer service deductions and adjust standard deduction rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 170 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent tax deductions applicable to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025, with annual inflation adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: applicable to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025

missing_information: Exact revenue loss estimate (Joint Committee on Taxation score) for the federal government.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide a charitable tax deduction for volunteer firefighters and emergency medical and rescue personnel based on hours of service rendered.

latest_action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
